item.title: Defiant Iran vows to fight 'until complete victory,' despite heavy military losses
item.summary: An Iranian military spokesman said Tuesday that Tehran's armed forces will battle "until complete victory," despite the U.S. reporting heavy losses for them.

item.title: Body of 20-year-old missing student canoer recovered after multiday search on Connecticut lake
item.summary: Dominick Tocci, a 20-year-old College of the Holy Cross junior, was found dead in Lake Hayward after his canoe capsized in East Haddam, Connecticut.

item.title: American officials issue 'worldwide caution' advisory for travelers amid global conflict
item.summary: The State Department issued a "worldwide caution" alert warning Americans abroad about Iran-linked threats, urging heightened caution in the Middle East.

item.title: Ex-Trump counterterror chief Kent clashes with Levin, rejects Iran threat claims
item.summary: Joe Kent claims Israel "forced President Trump into this war" in a heated Levin interview, denying leak allegations and disputing Iran intelligence.

item.title: NATO scrambles jets as Russia fires nearly 400 drones toward Ukraine, signaling new spring offensive
item.summary: Russia launched nearly 400 drones and missiles at Ukraine, prompting Poland and Romania to scramble NATO fighter jets as strikes neared their airspace.

item.title: Retired general calls for US ground operation to seize Iranian island, cut off regime's 'economic lifeline'
item.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. Keith Kellogg said seizing Iran’s Kharg Island and securing the Strait of Hormuz with U.S. ground forces could break Tehran’s control over global oil flows.

item.title: Senate Republicans move to reopen DHS with new plan, wait for Democratic buy-in
item.summary: A new Senate Republican framework would fund most of DHS but leave ICE enforcement unfunded, as Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, DpN.Y., says Democrats need to review the proposal.

item.title: Oklahoma Gov Kevin Stitt announces who he's tapping to replace Markwayne Mullin in the US Senate
item.summary: Republican Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt announces Alan Armstrong as his choice to fill the U.S. Senate seat vacated by next DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler mysteriously withdraws from PGA event just 2 weeks before Masters
item.summary: Scottie Scheffler pulled out of the Houston Open before the Masters, sparking concern after a rare slump interrupted his dominant run of top-10 finishes on the PGA Tour.

item.title: Senator's resurfaced comment on who Democrats care about the 'most' sparks online outrage: 'He really said it'
item.summary: Resurfaced clip of Sen. Chris Murphy calling undocumented immigrants the people Democrats care about most is fueling conservative outrage on social media.
